name: repo-docs
description: Write documents as Markdown in the repository, never in an agent's own document storage. Use whenever a task produces a report, brief, record, plan, design note, review, findings or notes meant to outlive the conversation, when a tool offers to create a doc, canvas, page or artifact for one, or when moving such a document out of agent storage.
